description: Every film in a Refs collection as search cards (REF id, link, length, aspect, measured metrics, why it works). Takes a collection id or refs.video/c/… link: anyone's shared collection, or your own private one; "favourites" gives the films you hearted. Then use them as references: plan_video(brief, reference_ids) with up to 5 that fit the brief, get_blueprint for one film in full. Needs a Refs account with Pro; without one, the app asks the user to sign in. search_videos is free.
